description_en: You can invoke StartBack2BackCall to initiate a back-to-back call
name: StartBack2BackCall

parameters.description_en: The timeout for the dual-call, in seconds. If the call is not answered within the specified time, it will be automatically disconnected. This parameter is optional and defaults to 30 seconds.
parameters.description_zh: 双呼超时时间，呼叫在经过该参数指定的时间仍然未接通的情况下，则主动挂断，非必填，默认30，单位秒。
parameters.help_en: The timeout for the dual-call, in seconds. If the call is not answered within the specified time, it will be automatically disconnected. This parameter is optional and defaults to 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 双呼超时时间，呼叫在经过该参数指定的时间仍然未接通的情况下，则主动挂断，非必填，默认30，单位秒
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.description_en: The intermediate number, which must be an active outbound number under the instance. This number is used to sequentially call the caller and the callee in a double-call scenario.
parameters.description_zh: 中间号码，需要是实例下可用的外呼号码，双呼时会使用该号码先后呼叫主叫和被叫。
parameters.help_en: The intermediate number, which must be an active outbound number under the instance. This number is used to sequentially call the caller and the callee in a double-call scenario
parameters.help_zh: 中间号码，需要是实例下可用的外呼号码，双呼时会使用该号码先后呼叫主叫和被叫
parameters.name: broker

parameters.description_en: Additional intermediate number. If this parameter is provided, the intermediate number specified by the Broker parameter is used to call the caller, and the number specified by this parameter is used to call the callee. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty.
parameters.description_zh: 附加中间号码，如果该参数存在，则呼叫主叫时使用中间号码，呼叫被叫时使用该参数指定的号码，非必填， 默认空。
parameters.help_en: Additional intermediate number. If this parameter is provided, the intermediate number specified by the Broker parameter is used to call the caller, and the number specified by this parameter is used to call the callee. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 附加中间号码，如果该参数存在，则呼叫主叫时使用中间号码，呼叫被叫时使用该参数指定的号码，非必填， 默认空
parameters.name: additional_broker

parameters.description_en: Ingest endpoint data. It must not exceed 128 bytes and is primarily used for extension purposes. Ordinary customers do not need to concern themselves with it.
parameters.description_zh: 随路数据，不能超过128字节，主要用于扩展需求，普通客户无需关心。
